interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer

interventions.description: Adding a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at key crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to physically enforce low vehicle speeds in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Ensure the walkway remains clear of residential debris and trash bins to maintain a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Prune overhanging branches and bushes to ensure the sidewalk remains clear and sightlines are maintained.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Vertical Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase physical and psychological separation from vehicles.

interventions.description: Clearly mark the sidewalk across the driveway with paint or different materials to reinforce pedestrian priority and alert drivers.

interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.
